BTC is holding the ETF cost basis. That line sits near $81.5K, and every daily close for the last 3 weeks has held above it. A large block of bids waits just below. A break under this level could set off forced selling and deepen the drop. https://x.com/i/article/2110391618755031040

The cost basis of investors that bought the top still caps BTC's upside. Holders who bought 1 to 2 years ago sold heavily as $BTC rallied toward $88k, where the 6 to 12 month group breaks even. Price stalled just under it. That selling has since slowed considerably.

$BTC has bounced off the ETF cost basis. Price spent most of this year below that level, and the May rally stalled right under it. It has now held twice as support around $81.5k. Below it, the next major level is the True Market Mean at $77.5k.
